zh-CN.title: 气泡预览现在就是真实聊天页
items: 聊天页新增专用预览模式，个性化页面直接复用真实消息、Header 和输入栏结构
图片、视频、语音、文件、位置、足迹和链接均由正式消息组件渲染，不再使用近似 mock
预览内可以滚动浏览，但输入、语音、加号、媒体点击、长按和右键操作全部禁用

en.title: Bubble preview is now the real chat view
items: The chat page now has a dedicated preview mode, letting personalization reuse the real message, header, and composer structure
Images, video, audio, files, locations, travel maps, and links are rendered by production message components instead of approximate mocks
The preview remains scrollable while input, voice, plus actions, media clicks, long press, and context menus are fully disabled
